title: Keys on a layer with several shadows move the shadow you picked
goal: A title comes with two shadows, and adding a Drop Shadow puts a third at the bottom of its Effects list. Every shadow key (size, distance, direction, colour, opacity) moves only the first shadow, so someone who adds a shadow and keys its distance sees a different shadow move and their own stay put.
notes: Found 2026-10-06 while building a-shadow-s-offset-colour-and-softness-and-a-glow. Reproduced on the probe with /tmp/sgk/explore.json: typed title (Georgia 80 bold) shows Effects 2 shadows; panelMenu Add Effect > Shadow appends Shadow 3 (screenshot /tmp/photonz-playtest/sgk-explore/2-shadow-sc.png, Effects count 3). MotionProperty.shadow/.shadowDistance/.shadowDirection/.shadowColor/.shadowOpacity all apply to style.shadows.first (LayerMotion.swift applied/current), and glow keys to the first glow. Needs an index on a keyed shadow value (MotionProperty is a flat String enum, so likely a separate effect index on LayerMotion, defaulting to 0 for old files).
acceptance: On a title with three shadows, Animate a property says which shadow each shadow value belongs to, and keying Shadow 3 distance moves Shadow 3 only
Changing a keyed value in a shadow other than the first, in the Effects list at a second moment, adds a key to that shadow
The existing shadow keys on saved documents keep moving the first shadow

log.note: also true of borders (2026-10-06): Border width and Border color keys move only the FIRST Border in the Effects list; a second ring keeps its own values.

adversarial review before: Premiere gives each effect instance its own stopwatches, so a key belongs to one Drop Shadow, not to 'shadows'. The app names its shadows Shadow 1/2/3 in Effects, so the picker reuses those names. Risk found: keys addressed by position break when a shadow is removed or dragged, so remove/move/insert in the Effects list now carry keys with their shadow (and drop keys on a removed one). A plain typed title wears two shadows, so its picker grows from 5 to 10 shadow rows (count 14 -> 19 properties).

built: LayerMotion.effect (nil = first, so saved files are unchanged); KeyedProperty.motion(property, effect:) with title(on:); per-effect current/applied/keyStill/keyedMotion; lookPosed/editLooks/foldEditIntoKeys/lanes/stretch curve all effect-aware; Effects list remove/move/insert remap keyed motions (ColorStyles.swift). Tests: KeysOnSeveralEffectsTests (20), full suite 11,536 green. Walks: new keys-on-a-later-shadow-walk ok with 4 real captures; shadow-distance-keys, key-a-title-s-scale, properties-pane, properties-reset updated for Shadow 1 naming and the 19-value count, all ok; border-width-keys, glow-effect, separate-shadow, punch-in-and-hold ok.

left rough: the icon Motion list (MotionListInspector) still titles rows by property alone, so a later shadow's motion would read 'Shadow distance' there; that list only shows icon motions, which never key shadows, so no person sees it today.

Each keyed shadow, glow and border value names which one it moves (LayerMotion.effect; old files = first). Animate a property, rows and lanes read 'Shadow 3 distance'; keying it moves Shadow 3 only; dragging Shadow 3's Distance in Effects at a second moment adds a key there; removing/dragging an entry carries its keys. Verified: KeysOnSeveralEffectsTests + full suite (11,536) green; keys-on-a-later-shadow-walk ok at Next defaults with 4 real captures; 10 related walks ok. Commit eb02d641.
